purpose: Remove the production keyboard-soak consent race without weakening any keyboard, viewport, focus, caret, localization or mobile acceptance assertion.
rootCause: The active-chat soak used an immediate optional DOM count after starter activation. The required consent dialog can commit on the next render, so the helper sometimes returned before the mandatory modal appeared. The modal then stole focus during cycle two and the keyboard authority correctly remained closed because the textarea was no longer active.
requiredChecks: required consent dialog becomes visible after starter activation
consent is accepted and absent before the keyboard soak begins
20 active-chat keyboard cycles retain draft, caret, focus and composer geometry
exact-head Chromium and WebKit Gekta mobile acceptance
forbiddenChanges: weakening viewport, focus, caret or geometry assertions
adding retries or sleeps to mask a product failure
changing Gekta runtime components, API, auth, PostgreSQL or business logic
maturityBoundary: Code and CI do not prove production. Exact-SHA REG.RU release, three clean production browser runs and real iPhone/Android soak remain required.
